training: 483 independent reset RGB calibration pairs with privileged teacher labels; 6 physical teacher trajectories tested separately and may supplement training. Static resets are not physical successes.

runtime_boundary: Own RGB, fixed top RGB, saved models, own issued commands, phase/history only; no truth, velocity, contacts or setup pose feedback. Fixed top image crop per robot lane preserves rawcamera geometry.

acceptance.grasp: height>=.03m with bilateral contact and weld off continuously>=2s
